title: Wine, Cheese, Chocolate 6 Hour Tasting Tour with Lunch
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Travel time is included in total tour duration
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This wine tour is our best one yet! You'll be picked up at your hotel or Air BnB and transported into Niagara's wine country.

You will visit 5 of these amazing wineries (we include an extra on the list as a backup). You'll taste whites, reds, and of course no tour would be complete without some of Niagara's famous Ice Wine! 

Lunch will consist of a Picnic Board Cheese & Charcuterie

BONUS - Effective January 1st receive a complimentary Out of Town Lincoln souvenir wine glass to remember your tour! (while supplies last)
